objectives.text: Shear the flock and bring Tam 5 wool

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Here are the shears. Mind the near side. She kicks.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Aye. That's the five. Let me check the cut, then we'll settle up.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Five. And not a nick on any of them.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: That's more than I managed my first year. I took an ear off a ewe called Bett and she remembered it four seasons.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: I'll put the shears back in the shed.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Keep them. I've a second pair, and I'll not be needing either past this season. A tool wants using.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Come back in the spring if you're still about. There'll be five more, and they will not have got any politer.

quests.name: A Winter's Wool

quests.completionMessage: Keep the shears. A tool wants using.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: These pelts will do for Bram's boots. I'll start cutting them while you're out.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: The Lumberjack Trainer still hasn't brought my delivery. Go and ask what's holding him up. I need it before I can finish the order.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I haven't forgotten Nessa's delivery. The cutters won't take the load past those small coral snakes west of town.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Clear six of them from the approach, then come back and tell me. I'll see that she gets her delivery.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Good. I'll bring the load to Nessa myself. She still needs six wool for the boot linings, so take those to her while I get moving.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: That's the lining sorted. I'll send the finished boots out with the next patrol.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Ask Bram how they fit after he's walked in them. I want to hear about a bad seam before it wears through someone's heel.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: A full circuit and not a blister. Tell Nessa they fit. She'll want more of an answer than me turning up for another pair.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Bram has his boots, the cutters have their path, and I have paid you. I'm closing the shop before anyone else thinks of something.

quests.name: Boots for the Road

lines.speaker: npc

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: The watch pays what it posts. Come back tomorrow, there are always more of them.

quests.name: Goblin Culling
quests.lore: Goblins in the Rustpick Mine are breeding faster than we can count. The Binxonia watch pays for twelve. Report to me when it's done. (Mira, Binxonia watch)
quests.completionMessage: That'll hold them for a day. The board will say when it doesn't.

stages.text: Take 10 coffin plates from the crypt skeletons for Halden

objectives.text: Take 10 coffin plates from the crypt skeletons for Halden

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Ten plates. Four of these names aren't in the book at all, and one of them I buried myself, thirty years back, under a different name entirely.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: So. Before I work out what that means, what do you want done with it? Once I say it out loud to somebody official, it stops being mine to handle.

responses: Report it. Let the city deal with it.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Suppose that's right. Suppose I've been keeping a book about a thing that stopped being about books a while back. I'll send word up the hill. They'll do nothing for a month and then they'll do something stupid, but I'll have sent it.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: That's the last of them, then.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Thirty years I've kept that book straight. Now I've to go back through it and put a line under my own handwriting.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Do you want a hand with it?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: No. Go on, then. I've a book to correct, and I'd rather do that on my own.

quests.name: The Names on the Stones
quests.lore: Halden's ledger and the crypt disagree about how many are buried under the hill. He wants the brass plates off the coffins to settle it.
quests.completionMessage: I've a book to correct, and I'd rather do that on my own.

stages.text: Get down to the second chamber

objectives.text: Get down to the second chamber

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Eight of them. Walking.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I want to tell you that's normal for a crypt and that you're being dramatic.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: It isn't. And you're not.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: What do you want done about it?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Nothing tonight. Here, take this. It's what I've got.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Come back tomorrow. I want to look at my book.

quests.name: Someone's Been Digging
quests.lore: Halden Rooke sweeps the crypt step every third day and knows how the door sits. It is not sitting right.
quests.completionMessage: I'm still at that book. Give me a day with it.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Ferris Wick made candles. Good ones.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: My mother kept a pair on the shelf for years and never once burned them. Said they were too fine for a Tuesday.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Whatever was ringing that bell, it wasn't Ferris.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: No. And now it isn't anything at all.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: That's the best either of us was ever going to get out of this. Take your pick of what's on the table.

quests.name: The Bell-Ringer
quests.lore: A bell that has not rung in Halden's lifetime rang on Tuesday, in a room he sealed thirty-one years ago.
quests.completionMessage: Take your pick of what's on the table.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Wow, great job! Unfortunately, the Big Imp has doubled down. Please find and defeat the Big Imp! Take these health potions to help you.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: You did it! Thank you so much for helping save our market. Please take this reward.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Thanks for helping us with the Imps!

quests.name: Imp Menace
quests.lore: Imps are stealing from the market stall. Help us by defeating them.
quests.completionMessage: Thanks for helping us with the Imps!

quests.name: The Quiet Rows
quests.lore: Bandits have been skimming the north orchard for three weeks, never enough to bring the constable, always enough to notice. Jack Appleseed wants it answered with steel.

quests.name: Silver in the Deep
quests.lore: The tally book led to a silver seam at the bottom of the bandit cave, and to a name Constable Fenn has carried on his list for four years: Cull Marrow.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: It's out of my hands now.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: That's what I wanted, and it still sits badly.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Three weeks that book was under the floor of the press house. Every day I did nothing with it, I was deciding something.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: You decided today.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I did. Whatever happens next down in that cave, it starts here.

quests.name: What Jill Knows
quests.lore: Jill Appleseed doesn't think the bandits taking exactly enough not to be noticed is luck. She thinks it's bookkeeping, and she wants the book.

stages.text: Kill 6 giant spiders east of the Dark Witch's hut

objectives.text: Kill 6 giant spiders east of the Dark Witch's hut

objectives.text: Go back to the Dark Witch
Bring 10 caustic glands from the Midland Cave stag beetles

stages.text: Kill the Etcher past the side door by the Midland Cave stag beetles

objectives.text: Kill the Etcher past the side door by the Midland Cave stag beetles

stages.text: Go back to the Dark Witch

objectives.text: Go back to the Dark Witch

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Better. Now the part that matters.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: North of here there's a cave with a crossbones sign at the mouth. Just inside, on the first floor, you'll find stag beetles. They carry a gland under the jaw, full of the stuff I need.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Don't bother throwing acid at them. They live in it. Kill them the way you already know how.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: These will do for the jar. They won't do for you.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: There's a side door by those beetles, and past it lives one the size of a cart. The tunnels back there are smooth because it made them smooth. I call it the Etcher.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Kill it. That's the whole recipe. Come back when it's dead and I'll show you how to make it yourself.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: So the Etcher's gone. It was down there longer than I've been up here.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Here is the whole secret. Acid doesn't hurt much when it lands. It makes everything that lands after it hurt more.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Put it on something first, then hit it with whatever you like. Or let your friends do the hitting.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Hold out your hand. Not that one. The one you don't mind losing.

quests.name: What Cuts a Gem
quests.lore: The Dark Witch does not cut her gems. She eats them into shape with an acid she makes herself, and she has run out.
quests.completionMessage: Mind where you point it.

stages.text: Take 10 melted keepsakes back off the den imps

objectives.text: Take 10 melted keepsakes back off the den imps

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Put them on the table.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: That one's the Meara girl's. Her mother had it off her grandmother and it hung in the window where you could see it from the road.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: There are more down there.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: There will be. I'll take these round myself, and not tonight.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Go back down. The floor gets warmer the further in you go, and I want to know what has been keeping it warm.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Cold down there now?

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Getting there.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Nine years. That's the part nobody puts in a scroll. You will cast a thing that lands, and then keeps landing, and it will do that whether or not you are still standing there and whether or not you have changed your mind about it.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Eril thought the spell ended when the saying ended. It's the only thing he got wrong and it cost three houses.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Hold your hand out.

quests.name: Still Burning
quests.lore: Osric Blane taught one apprentice, nine years ago. The fire that boy read took three houses and then went down into the ground, and it has been going south ever since. The Smoldering Den is named after it and nobody ever asked why.
quests.completionMessage: Go and practice it somewhere with nothing behind it.

stages.text: Kill 6 wolves on the road south of Binxonia

objectives.text: Kill 6 wolves on the road south of Binxonia

stages.text: Kill 4 baby imps in the Imp Tree

objectives.text: Kill 4 baby imps in the Imp Tree

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: That will feed the family whose barn burned. Now for something I can't cook away.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: South of the church there's a cave people call the Imp Tree. Something has gotten into the roots down there.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Go down to the bottom and clear out four of the little ones.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: The roots are quiet. Good. Quiet is where this starts.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Healing isn't loud, and it isn't much to look at from outside. You press your hand to a wound, and something in you decides the wound is wrong and undoes a little of it.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: That's all mending is. Practice it kindly. I've seen it turned into a leash more than once, on people who didn't ask to be pulled by it.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Go on. You'll know when it's time to learn the rest.

quests.name: Small Mercies
quests.lore: The Priest already lends people strength for an hour at a time. He wants to teach a mage how to make it last.
quests.completionMessage: You'll know when it's time to learn the rest.

stages.text: Take back 12 lengths of shaft iron

objectives.text: Take back 12 lengths of shaft iron

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Twelve. That's the eleven they cut out and the one they had started on.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: It goes back up riveted this time, not bolted, so the next lot has to work for it.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: And the gallery?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Still not a place I would send anybody. Which is the next thing I am going to ask you to do, so I will not pretend otherwise.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: It went into the cowl about an hour ago. First weather since the iron went back up.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: I felt it come down the ladder.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: It went into the cowl because the cowl was there and nothing else was. That's the whole of it. It isn't strength and it isn't aim. It is finished by the time you hear it, and the only question is whether the right thing was standing in the right place beforehand.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Rowan and Ide weren't. Come down to the sump and I'll show you what Ide wrote on the pump housing, because he could never keep his hands still either.

quests.name: The Fourth Gallery
quests.lore: Rustpick's air shaft was lined with iron from the cowl to the sump until goblins came up through a crack and took the lining out for scrap. The next storm came down the bare shaft and found the fourth gallery.
quests.completionMessage: Come down to the sump when you've a minute. Ide wrote something on the pump housing.

quests.name: Iron for the Forge
quests.lore: The smiths at the Mining Trainer's stall use iron faster than anyone brings it in.

quests.name: Downwind of Mossreach
quests.lore: Ossa Penhallow has watched Mossreach Swamp creep forty paces past her old cutting beds in three years, and she thinks the harpies on Gregor's road and the moving bog are the same story.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: You found them. Oh. They're smaller than Grumbo remembers.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: This one is Bessie. She liked honey, and sitting on logs until the logs broke.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: This one is Big Tom. He wasn't big. It was a joke name. Everybody laughed, Tom most of all.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Grumbo doesn't know this one. But Grumbo is sure it was a good bear.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Goodbye, bears. You were very round and very good.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Grumbo has one more question, and it's a scary one. Are there any bears left anywhere? The boat man at the dock goes over the water. Ask him. Grumbo can't. What if he says no?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Bears? The big fellow by the wreck sent you, didn't he? He's been staring at my boat all week.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Tell him yes. The woods around Underleaf are full of them. Linnet Birch up there thinks there are too many.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: And tell him I'll row him across for nothing, as long as he sits still. I've seen him sit down. The whole dock moved.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Lots of bears? Too many bears? There is no such thing as too many bears.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Grumbo is going to Underleaf. Grumbo will sit very still in the woods and let the bears come to him. Grumbo is good at sitting.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: And Grumbo is never eating meat again. Only fish. Fish don't have ears. Grumbo checked.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Take this. It's all the shiny things Grumbo found in the sand. Grumbo doesn't need shiny things. Grumbo needs bears.

quests.name: Unbearable
quests.lore: Grumbo, a gentle ogre on the Ogre Isle beach, loved the island's bears. His kin hunted them to the last and smoked the meat, which is why ogres carry cooked bear in their belts.
quests.completionMessage: Take this. It's all the shiny things Grumbo found in the sand. Grumbo doesn't need shiny things. Grumbo needs bears.

quests.name: Pirates' Treasure
quests.lore: Pirates down the coast from Plymouth robbed the wharf of the gold its fishermen had pooled. James Hookman wants them taught a lesson.

quests.name: Cargo for the Isle
quests.lore: The supplies bound for Ogre Isle never got there. Ogres holed up east of Underleaf took them off the road.

stages.text: Saw 10 pine planks at the sawmill in Hollis Tamber's yard at Plymouth Wharf and bring them to him.

objectives.text: Saw 10 pine planks at the sawmill in Hollis Tamber's yard at Plymouth Wharf and bring them to him.

stages.text: Hammer out 5 sets of iron fittings at the anvil in Hollis Tamber's yard and bring them to him.

objectives.text: Hammer out 5 sets of iron fittings at the anvil in Hollis Tamber's yard and bring them to him.

stages.text: Speak with Hollis Tamber at Plymouth Wharf.

objectives.text: Speak with Hollis Tamber at Plymouth Wharf.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Here's a saw and twenty pine logs. Hold the saw in your off hand and run the logs through the sawmill, two to a plank. I want ten. The hammer and the ore are for later.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Straight enough. Now the ironwork. Take the hammer to that ore at the anvil, one ore to a set, and bring me five sets of fittings.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Good. You'll want a lot more of both before you build anything of your own.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: That's the trade. Planks at the sawmill, fittings at the anvil. The finer woods and metals come with practice.

quests.name: The Carpenter's Trade
quests.lore: Hollis Tamber patches every boat that ties up at Plymouth Wharf, and he has more hulls than hours.
quests.completionMessage: That's the trade. Planks at the sawmill, fittings at the anvil. The finer woods and metals come with practice.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Word travels fast out there. They knew before you did, probably.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Robbing his own kin. That is what it took to earn that name with them.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Get down to the dock. You've earned the crossing.

quests.name: The Ogre Traitor
quests.lore: The shipment was meant for the Ogres on Ogre Isle and one of their own took it. They call him the Traitor for that, and they want him dead before anything else crosses.
quests.completionMessage: The water's quiet for the first time in years. Dock's this way.

stages.text: Bring 6 Rustpick lamps to Foreman Cobb Harrow

objectives.text: Bring 6 Rustpick lamps to Foreman Cobb Harrow

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Dry as bones, every one. Well, oil's cheaper than brass.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: That's a full shift down tonight. Here, you've earned this.

quests.name: Lamps Out
quests.lore: Goblins in the Rustpick workings have been stealing the miners' lamps for their oil. Foreman Cobb Harrow can't send a shift down in the dark.
quests.completionMessage: That's a full shift down tonight. Here, you've earned this.

stages.text: Bring 8 retainer's knives to Warden Maud Ferrow

objectives.text: Bring 8 retainer's knives to Warden Maud Ferrow

stages.text: Learn the dagger from Warden Maud Ferrow

objectives.text: Learn the dagger from Warden Maud Ferrow

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Eight. I'll wrap them and put them back in the coffins.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: They didn't want to give them up.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: They were sworn to guard the king's door. So was Odric the Knifeward, the captain of the knife-guard. He walks the catacomb on the third floor, near the stair down.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Put him down and the rest of them will lie quieter.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: So Odric's resting at last. Good.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Take this one. My grandmother carried it at the king's door, back when the door still had a king behind it.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: It's light.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: That's the point of it. A dagger wants you close. Stay inside their reach, cut low, and step out before they can swing.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Go on, show me. Again, and lower this time.

quests.name: The Mercy Knives
quests.lore: King Jordon's retainers were each buried with a mercy knife, and now they carry them through the tomb. Warden Maud Ferrow wants the knives back.
quests.completionMessage: Stay close, cut low, and step out before they can swing.

stages.text: Bring 8 stolen smith tools to Hester Bell

objectives.text: Bring 8 stolen smith tools to Hester Bell

stages.text: Learn the mace from Hester Bell

objectives.text: Learn the mace from Hester Bell

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Eight bells. They're mine, all right. I can fit new handles.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: The goblins were taking them deeper.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Nib the Toolkeeper counts everything they steal. You'll find him in the west end of the fourth floor. While he's down there, the next cart isn't safe either.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: The cart came through. Driver said he didn't see a goblin all morning.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Here, take this mace. Hold it a little lower. You're choking the haft.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Like this?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: That's it. Keep your wrist straight and turn with the blow. Let the head do the work. I'll watch you try a few before you go.

quests.name: The Broken Hammers
quests.lore: Hester Bell's tools are turning up in Rustpick with their handles broken. The goblins have a use for the iron and no use for the smith who made it.
quests.completionMessage: Keep your wrist straight. Let the head do the work.

stages.text: Bring 8 stolen patrol fittings to Guard Tobin Reed

objectives.text: Bring 8 stolen patrol fittings to Guard Tobin Reed

stages.text: Learn the spear from Guard Tobin Reed

objectives.text: Learn the spear from Guard Tobin Reed

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: These will do. The shafts we can replace ourselves.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: They'll come for the next cart.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Varruk will. He leads their raids from the southwest edge of that same camp. Deal with him before I put another patrol on the road.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I'll send the patrol out before dusk. They'll be glad of their kit.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: This spear's yours. Put your rear hand here and face me.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: You're well out of reach.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Of your sword, yes. Take half a step. There. That's where you want the other fellow when he starts his swing.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Keep the point between you and the trouble. Give yourself room to step back. We'll practice until your feet remember it.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I'll send the patrol out before dusk. They'll be glad of their kit.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: This spear's yours. Put your rear hand here and face me.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: You're well out of reach.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Of anything short, yes. Take half a step. There. That's where you want the other fellow when he starts his swing.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Keep the point between you and the trouble. Give yourself room to step back. We'll practice until your feet remember it.

quests.name: Beyond the Point
quests.lore: An orc raiding party near Underleaf has stripped the west patrol's spare equipment. Tobin Reed needs it back before he sends another pair of guards down that road.
quests.completionMessage: Keep the point between you and the trouble. Give yourself room to step back.

quests.name: Nothing Gets Through
quests.lore: A slide shut the gold mine out in the Wastelands. The only man still trying to open it is working with tools that gave up on him years ago.

stages.text: Bring Abel Munt his partner's pick

objectives.text: Bring Abel Munt his partner's pick

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: B, R, A, M. He scratched that in with a nail the night we bought it.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: You found it near the top? Then something knocked it out of his hand and he kept going down in the dark. That's Bram. Stubborn.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: His pick will be wherever he stopped. It has cord wrapped around the handle, same as mine. We cut both off one coil. Go to the bottom if you have to, and mind the warriors on the lower floors.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: That's his cord. Same coil as mine, see?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: All the way at the bottom, with her. He always said the good stuff was deeper.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Six years I've wondered. Knowing is better.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I'll hang his pick and his lamp over my pile. Here, take this. I put it aside for whoever finally told me.

quests.name: Down the Sinkhole
quests.lore: Abel Munt's partner, Bram Kettle, went down the sinkhole into the Antlion Hive six years ago and never came up.
quests.completionMessage: I'll hang his pick and his lamp over my pile. Here, take this. I put it aside for whoever finally told me.

objectives.text: Bring Nell Parrish Scrag's torn ear
Bring Nell Parrish Scrag's torn ear

stages.text: Bring Nell Parrish Scrag's torn ear

objectives.text: Bring Nell Parrish Scrag's torn ear

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Good pelts, hardly a hole in them. They'll go to Fred in the morning.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Now, Marta's been odd all week. She says something drinks at the well after dark, and she's been sitting up with a lamp. Go and ask her about it, would you? She won't tell me. She says I'll only worry.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Nell sent you. Of course she did.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: It's a jackal, but not like the ones you've been killing. He's big as a calf, gray all over, with one ear torn half off. The diggers call him Old Scrag.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: He comes up from a den south of the scrapyard and drinks my bucket dry. The last time I chased him off, he didn't run. He stood there and looked at me.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Put him down, please. Nell won't believe he's gone without proof, so take her his ear.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: That's Scrag's ear? Marta sat up every night with a lamp over him and never told me what it was.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: She'll sleep now, and so will I. Here's your pay. The pelts covered some of it.

quests.name: Jerky Weather
quests.lore: Nell Parrish wants her smoker full before the wind turns, and Marta Quill has been sitting up at night over the dry well.
quests.completionMessage: She'll sleep now, and so will I. Here's your pay. The pelts covered some of it.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Black wax. Raiders don't seal anything. They can't be bothered.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: The stamp on this chit and on the tokens is a Thak paymaster's mark. I've had their coin across my counter. It's heavy and badly struck, and nobody out here mints it but the Thak.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: So the outriders ride on Thak pay. I'll keep these. Go and tell the Bloomguard quartermaster at the post by my gate before somebody offers to buy the news off you.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Fred Skentz says the outriders are on Thak pay. Talin's chit carries a Thak paymaster's stamp.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Then Sergeant Vale was right, and I owe him a drink.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: If the Thak are paying raiders this far west, they want the road watched before their scouts come down it. Agauton needs to hear that. I'll send a rider east tonight.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Here's your pay from the post's box. Sergeant Vale said you'd earn it.

quests.name: Outriders
quests.lore: Dune Raider outriders camp across the road from the Ancient Battlefield. Sergeant Bennet Vale wants to know who pays them.
quests.completionMessage: Here's your pay from the post's box. Sergeant Vale said you'd earn it.

quests.name: The Matriarch
quests.lore: The flock that came down to Gregor's road answers to one bird on the Willow Downs cliff. Ossa wants her taken off it before the whole flock settles on Wispmeyer for good.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: That's my chain. He's bent three of the links, but it'll hold a stake.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I'll have traps back in the water by the next tide. The whole village eats better for this. Take something from the chest. The fish market chipped in.

quests.name: Gullet
quests.lore: Hill giant adolescents wade the shallows east of Windthorne and smash the village's fish traps. The biggest of them, Gullet, leads them there.
quests.completionMessage: I'll have traps back in the water by the next tide. The whole village eats better for this. Take something from the chest. The fish market chipped in.

quests.name: A Road Nobody Rides
quests.lore: Wispmeyer's supply wagons stopped coming after the last driver came back with the canvas cut open and wouldn't say why. Gregor Sr. wants the down road ridden and whatever's on it dealt with.

quests.name: The White Mare
quests.lore: A white mare has run loose on the down since the winter she came through Wispmeyer wearing a saddle and no rider. The Stablemaster wants her in his paddock before the harpies bring her down.
